payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (merged). LiveKitSfuBackend behind the SfuBackend trait: mints LiveKit HS256 JWT access tokens (iss/sub/nbf/exp + video grant roomJoin/canPublish/canSubscribe) — pure Rust (hmac+sha2+base64+serde_json), offline token minting, no livekit SDK / no native deps. 5 tests (incl. signature verification). Built by a subagent. Boot wiring of LiveKit via env (api key/secret/url) is a thin follow-on; the SFU config arm currently uses the fake backend.
